featured_reviews.review_text: To witness vehicle That look fast standing Still,one does need to visit the Ferrari showroom at BKC, Mumbai one of the only 3 showrooms in India. They had 3 models on display at the time when I visited,  the showroom itself has different wheel rims, colors combination & interior leather/fabric design options to view & select from. Dedicated customer lounge, the management is friendly & it's a pleasure interacting with them. The lighting is great as well, to see the flagship Ferrari models on display. A special place for extremely Special ownership experience.

featured_reviews.name: ATHARVA JAWANJAL (BAHISPS_230102298_14:00)
featured_reviews.review_text:
In two words - monstrously horrendous.

Explained :- Had booked an appointment for a tour in advance ( say at least a week ago ). My friends had specifically come from Delhi to Mumbai to look at a “ Ferrari “.  We even dressed for the occasion.
The lady who received us at the store made us feel “unwanted” from the very start.
Not even 10 minutes in the store and the lady says “ sorry I can’t entertain you any longer as I have a customer waiting “.
Terrible experience and a complete ruin on Ferraris brand and all that it stands for.
Not once were we given an apology for the terrible unprofessionalism of the staff. ( note :- they asked us to come at that specific time …. ).
The lady attending us had less passion about the cars than I have of watching Hamilton drive in Ferrari and well thanks to this showroom now I hate both.
The Ferrari logo atop of the building should be replaced by “ anyone passionate about cars DO NOT ENTER.
the lady is a Russel in Ferrari - crashing into everyone while cumulatively ruining everyone’s experience. Finally she perhaps needs a lesson in hospitality and Ferrari needs to change its official dealer provided of course that it wants to save its legacy which is fast diminishing.
